senses.gloss: f. (preced. wds.) formation of fruits or leaves.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 4:8:2">Y. Shebi. IV, end 35ᶜ</cite>, a. e. <he>שלשולן הוא חַנְטָן</he> their formation of chains is what in other trees is the formation of fruits. Ib. V, beg. 35ᵈ <he>עקרתה חַנְטוֹ</he> thou disregardest the time of its formation.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 5:2:6">Y. Maasr. V, 51ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>בח׳ והשרשה</he> as regards the law regulating the tithes according to the time of the formation of fruits and of taking root.—
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 15b:1">R. Hash. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>אחר חנטה לשביעית</he> for the laws concerning the fruits of the Sabbatical year the formation of fruits is the deciding mark.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 15a:8">Ib.ᵃ</cite> (in Chald. diction) <he>זיל בתר ח׳</he> be guided by &c.
<cite ref="Menachot 69a:2">Men. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ דפירא</he> the formation of the fruit, <he>ח׳ דעלה</he> the formation of the texture of leaves; v. <cite ref="E00693"><he>הֲנָצָה</he></cite>.
